'''Grek team''' was a strike unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Peden]] commanded the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] during a mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which saw the entire team massacred by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
